rows.rationale: Preserves the repeated what and bodily testimony without prematurely resolving the word's referent.

rows.after: What was from the beginning, what we have heard, what we have seen with our own eyes, what we looked upon and our hands touched, concerning the word of life—
rows.tsw_comparator: That which was from the beginning, which we have heard, which we have seen with our eyes, which we looked upon and have touched with our hands, concerning the word of life—

rows.rationale: Unpacks the departure clause while documenting the scope of the final all/not expression.

rows.rationale: Retains the absolute wording and unexplained seed metaphor instead of adding a habitual-sin qualification.

rows.rationale: Retains the unnamed giver and the distinction between sins without identifying the death-leading sin or turning the last clause into an absolute prohibition.
rows.before: If anyone sees a brother or sister committing a sin not leading to death, they should ask, and God will give life to that person—to those whose sin is not leading to death. There is sin leading to death; I am not saying that one should ask concerning that.
rows.after: If anyone sees a brother or sister committing a sin that does not lead to death, they should ask, and he will give that person life—to those whose sin does not lead to death. There is sin that leads to death; I am not saying they should pray about that.
rows.tsw_comparator: If anyone sees a brother or sister committing a sin not leading to death, they shall ask, and God will give life to that one—to those whose sin is not leading to death. There is sin leading to death; I do not say that one should ask concerning that.
